caption:
How to make AI keep it short (and stop the waffle)

Ask for a simple team message and you get "I hope you're all doing well", "please plan accordingly" and a thank-you paragraph. All that for one fact: the shop opens late on Monday.

"Keep it short" doesn't really work. A number does:

"[YOUR REQUEST]. Max [N] words. Lead with the key fact. No "I hope you're well", no filler at the end."

With a 25-word limit, the same message became one line: Monday we open at 11, not 9, because of a stock delivery.

Other limits that work: "3 bullets, one line each" or "one sentence first, details after".

Bonus: already got a long one? Paste it back with "Cut this in half. Keep every fact."

Send this to someone who still cuts AI's waffle by hand. Follow @nomorebusywork for one fix a day.
